name: Yandere-chan
source:
Hobbies: Watching Senpai, studying, bass guitar?, watching Senpai some more.

A cute, innocent and kind girl who couldn't harm a fly. Just look at her, does she look like a yandere? No, of course not. She just wants her Senpai to notice her. And he's always standing there looking cool, maybe a bit too cool. So cool, how can a completely ordinary girl like her even muster up the courage to go and talk to him?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43312]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
